title: Building my first iPhone & Apple Watch app to train for a 5K
summary: Sal Castoro built a custom 5K runner app using AI agents and Swift.
learn: Use Apple's WorkoutKit to create custom workouts that vibrate the wrist to signal transitions.
Leverage HealthKit to track cadence and heart rate to distinguish walking from jogging.
Host a dashboard on Cloudflare workers with a generous free tier.
Use AI agents to review health data and provide coaching feedback.
